**sdd/issue-814-engine-adapter/design**

Full file: openspec/changes/issue-814-engine-adapter/design.md (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-814). Tier lite. Implements specs/sdd-engine-adapter/spec.md under proposal D1–D6.

T1 brain/scripts/config/: config-verb.mjs PURE (planConfigWrite({config,path,value}) → {next, migrationsApplied, refusal}) + cli.mjs thin I/O. KNOWN_PATHS derived from migration defaults, never a second hand-written schema. Values parse JSON-first-then-bare-string. Migration draft brain-drafts/config-migrations-1.4.0.md (#806 numbering; renumber at land like #456's 0.11.0→1.2.0), declares sdd.engines: {}.
T2 gentle-ai.roles.mjs sibling data module — recorded declaration, _provenance endpoint '~/.claude/agents/sdd-*.md + Model Assignments table', date 2026-09-02; custom stages answered with the framework default producer role marked derived:true per-role, never silently 'recorded'.
T3 instructions validation in role-port.mjs beside the chooses_model clause: non-empty string | null, else throw naming stage+field; plain declares null everywhere.
T4 brain/scripts/roles/first-party/{adversary-cold-review.mjs, index.mjs}; firstPartyRole(stage) → role|null. Role text carries ZERO protocol literals. cold-review-prompt.mjs DELETED → review/lib/assemble-review-prompt.mjs keeps the derived-from-reader machinery and takes role text as ARGUMENT. Imports: review → roles/first-party, never back. Neutrality test: served object has no engine/map/routing key. ROLE_DEBT_TICKET constant+module+test deleted.
T5 brain:engines (harness/engines-cli.mjs): per SDD_ENGINES member loadInhabitant→resolveRoles, report per stage; --record writes sdd.engines.<name>={recordedAt, stages} via config-verb.mjs. Named readers of the key: the verb's next run (drift) + #323 later.
T6 INHABITANTS += gentle-ai (one line); TRIPWIRE deleted because it FAILED; resolve-challenger 'WHEN #312 LANDS' header updated; registry stays an explicit map (the SDD_ENGINES-scoped scan is NOT taken: first-party/ would need an exclusion rule bigger than the map).
Vocabulary (D6): engines = frameworks, platforms = agents; sdd.map cold-review 'claude' names ADR-0033's transport.
Slice seams for tasks: (config verb) / (adapter+parity) / (review rewiring); T4 must never split from T3 or instructions is an unread field for one PR's lifetime.
